description: List the digitised files attached to one US National Archives Catalog record — scanned page images, PDFs, audio and video — with a direct, public-domain download URL, file type and size for each. Use after nara_search or nara_record when you want the actual document rather than its description. Example: nara_digital_objects({ naid: "219756158" })

limit.description: Maximum digital objects to return (default 50, max 500)

naid.description: National Archives Identifier of the record whose scans you want, e.g. "219756158"

name: nara_digital_objects
title: Nara Digital Objects
